question: Will the US–Iran ceasefire remain in effect through Sunday, August 2, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if, as of the end of Sunday, August 2, 2026 (23:59 UTC), neither the United States nor Iran has officially declared the ceasefire terminated, and no confirmed, large-scale exchange of direct strikes between US and Iranian forces has occurred that would constitute a material breakdown of the cessation of hostilities.
- "No": Wins if, before or by the end of Sunday, August 2, 2026 (23:59 UTC), the ceasefire has broken down — defined as either side officially declaring the ceasefire or any governing agreement (including the Memorandum of Understanding) terminated, or a confirmed, large-scale exchange of direct strikes between US and Iranian forces constituting a material resumption of active hostilities.

Clarifications:
- Isolated, minor, or unconfirmed incidents that are not acknowledged by either government as ending the ceasefire do not alone satisfy the "No" condition; a material breakdown requires an official declaration or confirmed large-scale direct exchanges of fire between US and Iranian forces.
- Strikes attributed to proxies or third parties not officially acknowledged by the US or Iran as part of a mutual exchange do not alone constitute a ceasefire breakdown.
- If both sides are engaged in active negotiations and neither has formally declared the ceasefire over as of the settlement time, "Yes" wins even if sporadic violations have been reported.
